bio: Originally the home of an industrialist, this smart 19C villa now houses this splendid restaurant, with its high ceilings, fine parquet flooring and elegant table settings – the perfect setting to enjoy Ulrich Heldmann's ambitious cuisine. Whether you opt for the seasonal set menu or order à la carte, you will be served meticulously prepared, flavoursome dishes made with fresh ingredients. The terrace is of course the place to go in summer. Wednesdays and Thursdays also open at lunchtime....
